content:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - spike in token verification errors for /v1/auth/verify. Error rate ~18% (5xx) across us-east/us-west since 2026-03-15T12:03Z. Affected: Console logins + API token-based endpoints. Logs show downstream JWKS fetch to Auth0 returning 5xx. Please ACK and escalate. https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/91234

alex: ACK — I'm oncall. Seeing same in traces: auth-service failing to fetch JWKS, fallback not enabled. Shelling into auth pod now.

mira: on it. This looks like Auth0's jwks endpoint is intermittently 502/503. We can flip a config to allow using cached keys and increase JWKS retry backoff. Preparing quick mitigation.

sahil: I opened ticket with Auth0 support (ref: INC-Auth0-281). Status page: https://status.auth0.com/incident/2026-03-15-jwks (they list partial outage for jwks).

jack: Support: multiple customers reporting "login failed" and Console 500s. Top reports: Acme Corp, BetaApps, Digico. Raised high-priority Zendesk tickets, collecting logs and request ids.

alex: Plan: 1) enable stale JWKS fallback in auth service; 2) increasejwks retry to 6 attempts with exponential backoff; 3) monitor error rate. I'm going to apply env change and restart pods.

mira: Patch to run (kubectl):
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/auth AUTH_JWKS_ALLOW_STALE=true
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/auth AUTH_JWKS_RETRY=6
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/auth
```

ops-bot: Patch applied to deployment/auth by alex. Rolling restart started (3 pods).

alex: Rolling restart logs:
```
auth-1 restarting...
auth-1 READY
auth-2 restarting...
auth-2 READY
auth-3 restarting...
auth-3 READY
```

alex: After restart, token verification 5xx dropped from 18% -> ~4% in last 5 minutes. Login failures for affected orgs decreasing. Still seeing occasional JWKS 5xx from Auth0 but auth service now using cached key for most requests.

mira: Good short-term mitigation. For medium term we should persist JWKS to disk and implement hot-swap key logic so we don't block on remote jwks fetch. Also add a circuit-breaker around jwks fetch. I'll put proposals in the postmortem.

jack: Customer outreach: I've notified Acme Corp & BetaApps that we're mitigating and will follow up when fully resolved. Digico wants an incident report. Collecting logs now, will attach request IDs.

emma: Draft status update for our public status page and #status-updates channel: "We are investigating an issue causing login failures for some customers due to a third-party identity provider JWKS endpoint instability. We applied a temporary mitigation to use cached signing keys; users should see improvement. Engineers continue to monitor. More updates soon." Thoughts? :loudspeaker:

alex: LGTM, please post once Sahil confirms stabilization.

sahil: ACK taking over monitoring for next 2 hours. I'll keep watch on 5xx rate and coordinate with support for customer follow-ups. Contact me for handoff.

support-bot: Zendesk tickets linked: ZD-4432 (Acme), ZD-4433 (BetaApps), ZD-4434 (Digico).

incident-bot: Incident status changed: MITIGATING -> MONITORING.

alex: Creating incident doc and assigning action items: eng-security (mira) to own root cause + remediation, eng-runtime (alex) to add persistent JWKS cache, support (jack) to own customer comms. Will schedule postmortem.

mira: Quick log snippet for root cause evidence: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:04:21Z] auth-service WARN failed to fetch jwks from https://auth0.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json status=503 body="Service Temporarily Unavailable"
[2026-03-15T12:04:22Z] auth-service ERROR token verification failed kid=abc123 err="no matching key"
```

alex: Handing incident over to sahil. If we regress (error rate >8% for 5m) page me and I'll re-join.

sahil: ACK. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/auth?orgId=1. I'll update status if anything changes.

emma: Posted status update to public page & #status-updates. Notified account managers for the three impacted customers.

jack: Customer impact summary (preliminary): ~120 orgs experienced at least one failed login attempt; ~3 orgs reported repeated failures affecting user sessions. No data compromise reported.

incident-bot: Closing note: mitigation applied, monitoring for 60m. Please add any follow-up items to INC-2026-03-15-auth-jwks in the incidents tracker.
